T3_about.h2: What VARIANT II is and who it is for
T3_about.text: VARIANT II is a fully automated Bio-Rad system for HbA1c and β-thalassemia testing. It allows a laboratory to run diabetes testing and hemoglobinopathy studies on one platform. Base capacity can be expanded with an optional rack loader that also supports continuous loading.

rows.label: Capacity
rows.value: 10 samples; 50 samples and continuous loading are available with the optional rack loader

items.text: The sampling station accepts barcoded primary tubes, draws material from the closed tube, dilutes it and injects it into the chromatographic station. Separate manual sample preparation is not required.
Programs for HbA1c and β-thalassemia operate on the same system. For VARIANT II Dual Program, the manufacturer describes rapid switching between methods without changing the column or buffers.
Bio-Rad Clinical Data Management Software processes results. According to the manufacturer, the software can transmit them to a laboratory information system in real time.
The base configuration handles 10 samples. The optional rack loader expands capacity to 50 samples and adds continuous loading for a different workflow format.

items.q: Which tests is VARIANT II designed for?
items.a: VARIANT II is designed for HbA1c and β-thalassemia testing on one platform.

items.q: How many samples does VARIANT II hold?
items.a: Base capacity is 10 samples. With the optional rack loader, 50 samples and continuous loading are available.

items.q: Does VARIANT II require manual sample preparation?
items.a: No. The station draws material from a closed primary tube, dilutes it and injects it into the chromatographic station.

items.q: Who supplies VARIANT II in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is a Bio-Rad partner and supplier in Ukraine.
